Maria: handing off — quick summary before I go. Two active issues: 1) embed-evictions-eu-west1 -> elevated embeddings tail latency (~3-5s spikes). 2) async-job-queue backlog on worker-4 (processing stuck at ~30%). Mitigations applied: increased kvcache retention in eu-west1 (temp), scaled worker group +2, paused bulk ingest jobs. Will leave notes below.
Oncall Bot: Incident created INC-2026-478 (embed-evictions-eu-west1) severity=P2 — paging list updated.
Ashok: thx Maria. I pushed a canary rollback of model-v2-quant at 21:12, watching redis and eviction metrics. No clear change yet. Maria — did you see any trace ids?
Maria: trace id 0x9f3ab is the spike sample. Evictions line up with big prefix misses + a recent kvcache mem_tuning change. If eviction rate stays >10% we'll revert the kvcache param.
Devin: on the job queue — I found a DB deadlock on jobs table. Sample query that got stuck:
```sql
SELECT id, status FROM jobs WHERE status='processing' AND worker_id='worker-4' FOR UPDATE;
```
I restarted worker-4, it resumed processing. Suggest adding an index on (worker_id, status) to reduce locking. Monitoring query latency now.
Sara: I paused batch-import-2026 at 21:25, backlog is now ~2.1k; letting workers drain. Will only unpause when backlog <=1000.
Liam: Night priorities: 1) keep eviction rate <5% (watch kvcache.evictions) 2) drain backlog to <1k 3) if DB deadlocks recur, page @db-oncall and escalate. If anything else crops up ping me or @oncall. :thumbsup: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria: handoff complete. Added runbook notes and open actions in the shift doc (internal link). If you take an action, append a line in the doc. Leaving the slack channel to you all. Good luck!
